# gezor_cluster_install_token (Resource)

A new operator install token for a cluster. Destroying it revokes the token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gezor_cluster_install_token" "reinstall" {
  cluster_id  = gezor_cluster.prod.id
  ttl_seconds = 3600
  label       = "reinstall after node pool upgrade"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster id.

### Optional

- `label` (String)
- `operator_namespace` (String)
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) Lifetime, 300 to 604800 seconds.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace id or slug. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`. Changing it recreates the resource.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (Number)
- `id` (String) Token id.
- `install_command` (String, Sensitive)
- `status` (String) `active`, `used` or `expired`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Append @<workspace> to import from a workspace other than the provider default.
terraform import gezor_cluster_install_token.example <cluster_id>/<token_id>
```
